performance_case.causal_mechanism: A completed sequence of returns may encode whether recent price discovery was stable across both ordinary and large moves rather than merely its cumulative sign; only a fixed predecision trajectory state with incremental information beyond momentum, reversal, volatility and autocorrelation could justify one later economic screen.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may use only three frozen access-proven primary studies, verify only the identity and frozen coverage of the sealed pre-2025 Binance H1 corpus, and use the already authorized public OKX complete-candle route only as schema and prospective availability proof. It may return one deterministic low-complexity return-trajectory preregistration skeleton or close the family. Binance-to-OKX venue equivalence remains MISSING_PROOF. It cannot read factor or strategy outcomes, retain market values, train or fit a model, compute PnL or drawdown, register a hypothesis or candidate, run a strategy, open OOS, modify the active forward contract, deploy or activate Trading.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Only a later matched-capital experiment could test whether a predecision trajectory state avoids unstable downside paths without sacrificing broad upside participation. This literature-only task has zero immediate drawdown effect and all magnitude claims remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A bounded three-source screen can reject model-dependent trajectory narratives before runner and backtest work, while the one-idea cap and explicit closed-family dedup prevent another price-only indicator from displacing higher-readiness forward evidence.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: If one fixed low-complexity return trajectory has incremental predecision information and later survives equal-capital fees, adverse slippage, large-move stability, annual breadth and drawdown gates, it may improve fee-adjusted total PnL versus an unchanged BTC parent. The present task makes no alpha or performance claim.
